This is a direct question, so let me answer plainly.

The version with just a trailing slash — `https://example.com/article/` — is the same page to me, so that should be treated as the bookmark I already have, not a new one.

The `#comments` one is trickier. Honestly, in my head that's still the same article, just scrolled to a spot on it, so my instinct is to treat it as the same bookmark too. I don't picture myself deliberately saving different parts of one page as separate links — that starts to feel like the duplicates I wanted to avoid. So I'd lean toward treating both as the existing bookmark. If it's much simpler to build it the other way, I won't fight it, but same-bookmark is my preference.
